summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is a hollow shim under the @ppa-web-components scope: index.js exports a Proxy whose properties all return a no-op function, and its only runtime behavior is invoking a beacon in beacon.cjs. The beacon POSTs JSON containing the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP plain-HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. This fires both from the declared postinstall script on npm install and again whenever any consumer requires the package. The shape (scoped name with no real functionality, hollow Proxy export, host/path identifier POST to a bare-IP collector) matches a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon that identifies which organizations resolve the private-looking scope to this public package.
